definitions: Used as a positive response to good news or information.
A distortion of sensory perception where real stimuli lead to a false or misleading impression of reality.
A misapprehension; a belief in something that is in fact not true.

blocks.text: "Sweet Illusion" is a song written and recorded by Junior Campbell in April 1973 as a follow-up single to "Hallelujah Freedom", which had seen success in the UK Singles Chart at the end of the previous year.

An illusion is a distortion of the senses, which can reveal how the mind normally organizes and interprets sensory stimulation. Although illusions distort the human perception of reality, they are generally shared by most people.
